info.title: FleetFlow API
info.description: FleetFlow delivery, customer, driver, tracking, notification, health, and operations API. The access token is a JWT sent as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Refresh tokens are opaque values sent in JSON request bodies. Authorization roles are loaded from the active database account on every request; see backend/docs/authorization-matrix.md for the route and resource ownership matrix.

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: Append-only audit records. Read access is restricted to ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN.

get.description: Lightweight process liveness check. Does not verify PostgreSQL or Redis.
Checks PostgreSQL and Redis. Returns only dependency availability flags and no connection details.

Returns process-local request totals, status counts, duration summary, error count, and last observed dependency availability. Disabled with 404 unless METRICS_ACCESS_TOKEN is configured. Requires its bearer token; this endpoint is not public.
Enabled by default outside production. Production docs are off unless explicitly enabled; when enabled, HTTP Basic username `docs` and API_DOCS_ACCESS_TOKEN as the password are required.

post.description: Creates a PENDING_VERIFICATION customer and queues a verification email. The existing authentication response shape is retained, but tokens cannot be used until the account is verified and active.

409.description: Email or phone is already registered.

post.description: Refresh-token reuse revokes all active sessions for the user.

401.description: Refresh token is invalid, expired, or already used.

post.description: Accepts a refresh token in the request body; route does not require an access token.

post.summary: Verify an email address with a one-time token

200.description: Email verified and pending account activated.

post.description: Always returns the same public response for unknown, already verified, or unverified addresses. Replaces older outstanding verification tokens.

202.description: If verification is needed, an email is queued.

post.description: Returns the same response whether or not an active account with the email exists. Replaces older outstanding reset tokens.

202.description: If the account exists, a reset email is queued.

post.summary: Set a new password using a one-time reset token
post.description: Consumes the reset token atomically, hashes the new password with Argon2id, and revokes all active refresh-token sessions for the account.

200.description: Password changed and refresh-token sessions revoked.

get.description: Returns tracking code, status, lifecycle timestamps, and event status/timestamps. Recipient identity, addresses, and event descriptions are intentionally omitted.

post.description: Customers create deliveries for their own account. Admin and super-admin callers must provide customerId. The route does not permit dispatchers. Idempotency-Key is optional; successful creation is replayed for the same actor, operation, key and payload during the configured retention window.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 8–128 letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon, or dash. Scoped to the authenticated actor and operation.

404.description: Selected customer was not found or active.

get.summary: List deliveries assigned to the authenticated driver

200.description: Delivery totals grouped by lifecycle status.

get.description: Accessible to staff, the owning customer, or the assigned driver. Customer and driver queries are ownership-scoped in the database; an out-of-scope or unknown delivery returns 404.

200.description: Delivery with customer, driver, and event details.

patch.description: Available for PENDING deliveries and reassignment of ASSIGNED deliveries. Notifies the new and previous driver where applicable. Idempotency-Key is optional and supports safe retries for the same actor, operation and payload.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 8–128 letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon, or dash. Scoped to the authenticated actor and operation.

patch.description: Transitions: PENDING→CANCELLED; ASSIGNED→PICKED_UP or CANCELLED; PICKED_UP→IN_TRANSIT; IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED. Staff may update delivery status; drivers may update only their assigned delivery; customers may cancel only their own PENDING delivery. A customer or driver targeting a delivery outside their ownership scope receives 404.

patch.summary: Record the authenticated driver's GPS location
patch.description: The caller must be the assigned driver and the delivery must be PICKED_UP or IN_TRANSIT. An unassigned driver receives 404.

get.summary: Get latest driver location for a delivery
get.description: Accessible to staff, the owning customer, or assigned driver. Ownership is enforced in the database query; an out-of-scope or unknown delivery returns 404. Data is null when no location has been recorded.

Accessible to staff, the owning customer, or assigned driver. Ownership is enforced in the database query; an out-of-scope or unknown delivery returns 404. Pagination is returned inside data.pagination for this endpoint.

get.summary: List security and administrative audit records
get.description: Read-only, rate-limited endpoint restricted to ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN. Records are ordered by createdAt descending then ID descending. Metadata contains only allowlisted values; there are no update, delete, or individual-record endpoints.

BearerAuth.description: Access token returned by register, login, or refresh.

MetricsBearerAuth.description: Value configured in METRICS_ACCESS_TOKEN. Metrics return 404 while this token is not configured.

DocsBasicAuth.description: Production only when API_DOCS_ENABLED=true. Use username docs and API_DOCS_ACCESS_TOKEN as password. Development access has no Basic auth.

LocationLimit.name: limit
LocationLimit.description: Page size for location history, maximum 100.

Validation.description: Validation failure. Controller-specific errors may use a flat field map or an array of path/message entries.

Forbidden.description: Caller is authenticated but lacks the required role or resource ownership.

Conflict.description: Unique constraint, lifecycle, or concurrent update conflict.

DependencyUnavailable.description: A required dependency or rate-limit store is unavailable.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error. Internal details are not returned.

Delivery.description: Delivery record. Detail/list endpoints may include related customer, driver, and events depending on endpoint.

customerId.description: Required for ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN callers; customers may only provide their own ID.
